name: Family Favourites (UK)
summary: Fifty everyday dinners that British families cook on a normal weeknight.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
steps: Brown the mince in a large pan, then add the chopped onion and diced carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and tomato purée, add the stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Meanwhile, boil the peeled potatoes until tender, then mash with the butter and milk.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish and spread the mash over the top.
Scatter over the cheese and bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Shepherd's pie
steps: Brown the lamb mince in a large pan and pour off any excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and carrots and soften for 5 minutes, then stir in the flour and tomato purée.
Pour in the stock, Worcestershire sauce and thyme and simmer for 25 minutes. Stir in the peas at the end.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with the butter and milk.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the lamb in a dish, top with the mash and rough it up with a fork.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until the top is crisp and golden.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
ingredients: grated Parmesan or Cheddar, to serve
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and soften in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and cook until browned all over.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato purée, crumbled stock cube and oregano. Simmer for 20–25 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water following the pack instructions and drain.
Serve the sauce over the spaghetti with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Brown the mince with the chopped onion and garlic, then add the tomatoes, purée and herbs. Simmer for 20 minutes.
For the white sauce, melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk a little at a time until smooth and thick.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan).
Layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in an ovenproof dish, finishing with white sauce.
Top with the cheese and bake for 35–40 minutes until golden. Rest for 5 minutes and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
ingredients: soured cream and grated Cheddar, to serve
steps: Soften the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it, then stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, crumbled stock cube and a splash of water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the kidney beans and cook for 5 minutes more while the rice cooks.
Serve with rice, a spoonful of soured cream and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Beef stew and dumplings
steps: Toss the beef in the plain flour with salt and pepper, then brown it in batches in a casserole dish.
Add the chopped onion, carrots and celery and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato purée, Worcestershire sauce, stock and bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours.
Mix the self-raising flour, suet and a pinch of salt with about 5 tbsp cold water to a soft dough and shape into 8 balls.
Sit the dumplings on top of the stew, cover and cook for 20–25 minutes until risen and fluffy.

recipes.name: Homemade beef burgers
steps: Mix the mince, onion, egg, breadcrumbs and some salt and pepper with your hands.
Shape into 4 burgers and chill for 10 minutes if you have time.
Fry or grill the burgers for 4–5 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Lay a slice of cheese on each burger for the last minute and toast the buns.
Build the burgers with lettuce, sliced tomato and sauces.

recipes.name: Spaghetti and meatballs
steps: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and Parmesan and roll into about 20 small meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in the oil, then lift out.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the same pan, add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 10–15 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and serve topped with the meatballs and sauce.

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff
ingredients: 500 g rump or sirloin steak, cut into strips
steps: Put the rice on to cook.
Fry the beef strips quickly in the hot oil until browned, then lift out.
Add the butter, sliced onion and mushrooms to the pan and cook for 5–6 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and mustard, pour in the stock and bubble for 3 minutes.
Return the beef, stir in the soured cream and warm through. Scatter with parsley and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pepper steak stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the beef with the cornflour and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef in a very hot wok for 2 minutes, then lift out.
Stir-fry the sliced peppers and onion for 3–4 minutes, adding the garlic and ginger for the last minute.
Return the beef with the rest of the soy and the oyster sauce and toss until glossy.
Serve straight away with the rice.

recipes.name: Beef burritos
ingredients: soured cream and salsa, to serve
steps: Fry the chopped onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then add the mince and brown it.
Stir in the spices and beans with a splash of water and cook for 5 minutes.
Heat the rice following the pack instructions.
Warm the tortillas, then fill each with rice, the beef mixture and cheese.
Roll up tightly and serve with soured cream and salsa.

recipes.name: Corned beef hash
ingredients: brown sauce or ketchup, to serve
steps: Dice the potatoes and boil for 8 minutes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the potatoes and fry until golden.
Cut the corned beef into chunks and add with the Worcestershire sauce. Fry, pressing down, until crisp underneath.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Serve the hash topped with an egg, with brown sauce or ketchup.

recipes.name: Sausage and mash
steps: Heat the grill or oven and cook the sausages for 20 minutes, turning, until browned.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with half the butter and the milk.
For the gravy, cook the sliced onions slowly in the rest of the butter for 10 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in the flour, then gradually add the stock and simmer until thickened.
Cook the peas and serve with the sausages, mash and onion gravy.

recipes.name: Toad in the hole
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the sausages and oil in a roasting tin and cook for 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a smooth batter with a pinch of salt.
Pour the batter quickly into the hot tin around the sausages and bake for 25–30 minutes without opening the door.
Meanwhile, soften the sliced onions, stir in the flour and add the stock to make an onion gravy.
Serve in big squares with the gravy, greens and mash if you like.

recipes.name: Gammon, egg and chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with oil and salt and roast for 35 minutes, turning once.
Snip the fat on the gammon steaks so they stay flat.
Grill or fry the gammon for 3–4 minutes each side, adding pineapple rings to warm through if using.
Fry the eggs and cook the peas.
Serve the gammon with an egg on top, chips and peas.

recipes.name: Sausage casserole
ingredients: mashed potato or crusty bread, to serve
steps: Brown the sausages in a large pan, then lift out and cut in half.
Soften the sliced onion, pepper and garlic in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, tomatoes, stock and herbs.
Return the sausages, add the beans and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Serve with mash or crusty bread.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
ingredients: 150 g smoked pancetta cubes or bacon lardons
steps: Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water.
Fry the pancetta in the oil with the bashed garlic clove until crisp, then remove the garlic.
Beat the eggs with most of the Parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water, and toss it in the pancetta pan off the heat.
Stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water until creamy. Serve with the rest of the cheese.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour pork
ingredients: 227 g tin pineapple chunks in juice
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the pork in the cornflour.
Mix the pineapple juice from the tin with the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce and sugar.
Stir-fry the pork in the hot oil for 4–5 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Stir-fry the chopped peppers and onion for 3 minutes, then add the pineapple and the sauce.
Return the pork and bubble until the sauce is glossy. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sausage pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the pack says.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of the skins and fry in small pieces until browned.
Add the chopped onion, courgette and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the tomatoes, purée and oregano.
Mix the drained pasta into the sauce and tip into an ovenproof dish.
Top with torn mozzarella and Cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.name: Pork chops with apple mash
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes, then add the peeled, chopped apples and cook for 5 minutes more.
Season the pork with sage, salt and pepper and fry in the oil for 4–5 minutes each side.
Lift the pork out to rest, pour the stock into the pan and bubble to a quick gravy.
Drain the potatoes and apples and mash with the butter and milk. Cook the green beans.
Serve the pork on the apple mash with beans and the pan gravy.

recipes.name: Bacon, pea and broccoli risotto
steps: Fry the chopped bacon in the oil until crisp, then add the chopped onion and soften.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the stock a ladleful at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes.
Add the small broccoli florets and peas for the last 5 minutes.
When the rice is tender, stir in the butter and Parmesan.
Rest for 2 minutes, then serve.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 100 g Gruyère or mature Cheddar, grated
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a 23 cm tart tin with the pastry and chill for 10 minutes.
Line with baking paper and beans and bake for 15 minutes, then remove the paper and bake for 5 minutes more.
Fry the lardons and chopped onion until golden. Whisk the eggs, cream and milk with pepper.
Scatter the bacon and cheese into the case, pour in the egg mixture and bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 30 minutes until just set.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve with salad and new potatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt and 1 tbsp of the curry paste and leave while you prepare the rest.
Soften the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in a little oil, then stir in the remaining paste.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Grill or fry the chicken until lightly charred, then add it to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes. Cook the rice.
Stir in the cream and garam masala, scatter with coriander and serve with rice and naan.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with the paprika, cumin, half the lime juice and the oil.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes until cooked, then lift out.
Fry the sliced peppers and onion for 4–5 minutes until softened and charred at the edges.
Return the chicken, squeeze over the rest of the lime and warm the tortillas.
Serve everything on the table with soured cream, sliced avocado and cheese for everyone to wrap their own.

recipes.name: Chicken and leek pie
ingredients: new potatoes and green veg, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the sliced leeks and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock, cream and thyme and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Spoon the filling into a pie dish and cover with the pastry, pressing the edges down.
Brush with egg, make a small hole in the middle and bake for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
Serve with new potatoes and green veg.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles following the pack instructions, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in the vegetable oil for 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the sliced pepper, carrot matchsticks, mangetout and garlic and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy and oyster sauce and toss everything together.
Scatter with sliced spring onions and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Toss the potatoes, onion wedges, sliced peppers and whole garlic cloves with the oil, paprika and oregano in a large roasting tin.
Sit the chicken on top, skin side up, season and add the lemon cut into wedges.
Roast for 45 minutes until the chicken is golden and the potatoes are tender.
Squeeze over the roasted lemon and serve straight from the tin.

recipes.name: Hunter's chicken
ingredients: 4 corn on the cob or a green salad, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and paprika and roast for 35 minutes.
Wrap each chicken breast in 2 rashers of bacon and put in an ovenproof dish.
Roast for 20 minutes, then spoon over the BBQ sauce and top with the cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes more until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with the wedges and corn or salad.

recipes.name: Chicken Kiev
steps: Mix the butter, garlic and chopped parsley and chill for 10 minutes. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Cut a deep pocket in the side of each chicken breast and stuff with the garlic butter.
Dip the chicken in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Brown briefly in the oil, then bake for 20–25 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with boiled new potatoes and peas.

recipes.name: Cheesy chicken pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes, and drain.
Fry the chicken in the oil until golden, add the sliced onion and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Stir in most of the cheese.
Mix the pasta, broccoli, chicken and sauce in an ovenproof dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Homemade chicken nuggets
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and put the chips in.
Squeeze the grated veg dry in a clean tea towel and mix with the chicken mince and garlic.
Shape into about 20 small nuggets.
Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs, and put on an oiled baking tray.
Drizzle with oil and bake for 18–20 minutes, turning once, until golden. Serve with chips, peas and ketchup.

recipes.name: Roast chicken dinner
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the halved lemon inside the chicken, rub with olive oil and season.
Roast for about 1 hour 20 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Parboil the potatoes for 8 minutes, shake to rough up, then roast in hot vegetable oil for 50 minutes.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes while you cook the carrots and broccoli.
Stir the flour into the roasting tin juices, add the stock and bubble to a gravy. Carve and serve.

recipes.name: Smoky chicken drumsticks with slaw
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the paprika, honey, oil and garlic and coat the drumsticks.
Roast for 40–45 minutes, turning once, until sticky and cooked through.
Cook the rice.
For the slaw, finely shred the cabbage, grate the carrots and mix with the mayonnaise and yoghurt.
Serve the drumsticks with rice and slaw.

recipes.name: Chicken enchiladas
ingredients: soured cream and green salad, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Fry the chicken, onion and pepper for 8 minutes, then add the spices.
Stir in half the passata and the sweetcorn and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken mixture, roll up and lay them side by side in a baking dish.
Pour over the rest of the passata and scatter with the cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden. Serve with soured cream and salad.

recipes.name: Chicken casserole
steps: Season the chicken and brown it in the oil in a casserole dish, then lift out.
Soften the sliced onions and peppers for 8 minutes, adding the garlic and paprika at the end.
Pour in the tomatoes and stock, add the bay leaf and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer gently for 35 minutes until the chicken is tender. Cook the rice.
Serve the casserole spooned over the rice.

recipes.name: Fish pie
ingredients: 400 g fish pie mix (salmon, cod and smoked haddock)
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash with half the butter and a splash of the milk.
Gently poach the fish in the rest of the milk with the bay leaf for 5 minutes, then lift out the fish and keep the milk.
Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour and whisk in the warm milk to a smooth sauce. Add the parsley.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the fish and peas in a dish, pour over the sauce and top with mash.
Scatter with cheese and bake for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Fish and chips with peas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into chunky chips, toss with 2 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 40 minutes.
Dip the fish in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Put the fish on an oiled tray, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake for the last 15 minutes of the chips' time.
Cook the peas, then roughly crush with the butter.
Serve the fish and chips with crushed peas, lemon wedges and tartare sauce.

recipes.name: Fish finger sandwiches
ingredients: 500 g skinless white fish fillets (e.g. basa or cod)
4 soft white rolls or 8 slices bread
steps: Cut the fish into thick fingers.
Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 2–3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Spread the rolls with mayonnaise or tartare sauce and add some lettuce.
Fill with the hot fish fingers and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Salmon fishcakes
ingredients: salad and frozen peas, to serve
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain well and mash. Steam or microwave the salmon for 5 minutes and flake it.
Mix the mash, salmon, sliced spring onions, chopped parsley and lemon zest. Shape into 8 cakes and chill for 15 minutes.
Dip the cakes in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 3–4 minutes each side until golden and hot through.
Serve with lemon wedges, salad and peas.

recipes.name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last minute, and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then gradually whisk in the milk until thick and smooth.
Stir in most of the cheese, then the tuna, sweetcorn, pasta and peas.
Tip into an ovenproof dish and scatter with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Kedgeree
steps: Poach the haddock in a pan of simmering water for 5 minutes, then lift out and flake. Keep the water.
Soften the chopped onion in the butter, stir in the curry powder and turmeric, then add the rice.
Add 600 ml of the fish water, cover and simmer for 12 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool, peel and quarter.
Fork the fish and parsley through the rice, top with the eggs and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Prawn fried rice
ingredients: 2 x 250 g pouches cooked long-grain rice
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok and fry the garlic and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute.
Add the peas and sweetcorn and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble the beaten eggs in the space, then mix through.
Add the rice and prawns and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until piping hot.
Season with the soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with the green spring onion tops.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon with noodles
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush the salmon with half the teriyaki sauce and the honey and bake for 12–15 minutes.
Cook the noodles following the pack instructions and drain.
Stir-fry the broccoli and sliced pepper in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, the rest of the teriyaki sauce and the soy sauce and toss together.
Serve the salmon on the noodles, scattered with spring onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Macaroni cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cook the macaroni for 2 minutes less than the pack says.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Take off the heat and stir in most of the Cheddar and the mustard powder.
Mix in the drained macaroni and tip into a baking dish. Top with tomato slices, breadcrumbs, Parmesan and the rest of the Cheddar.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Jacket potatoes with beans and cheese
ingredients: salad leaves and cherry tomatoes, to serve
steps: Prick the potatoes and microwave for 12–15 minutes until nearly soft.
Rub with oil and salt and crisp in the oven at 220°C (200°C fan) for 20 minutes.
Warm the baked beans in a pan.
Split the potatoes, add a knob of butter and spoon over the beans.
Top with the cheese and serve with a simple salad.

recipes.name: Tomato soup and cheese toasties
ingredients: 150 g Red Leicester or Cheddar, grated
steps: Soften the chopped onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth and season to taste.
Spread 4 slices of bread with pesto, top with cheese and the remaining bread, and butter the outsides.
Fry the toasties for 2–3 minutes each side until golden and melted. Serve with the soup for dunking.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and chickpea curry
steps: Soften the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in a little oil, then stir in the curry paste.
Add the peeled, diced sweet potatoes, coconut milk, tomatoes and peanut butter.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender. Cook the rice.
Stir in the chickpeas and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Pea and mozzarella frittata
ingredients: salad and crusty bread, to serve
steps: Heat the grill. Beat the eggs with the Parmesan, chopped herbs and some salt and pepper.
Soften the sliced spring onions in the oil in an ovenproof frying pan, then add the peas.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently for 6–8 minutes until almost set.
Tear the mozzarella over the top and grill for 3–4 minutes until golden and set.
Cut into wedges and serve with salad and crusty bread.

recipes.name: Pesto pasta with peas
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Drain, keeping a cupful of the cooking water.
Return to the pan with the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Stir in the pesto, lemon zest and a splash of the cooking water to make it glossy.
Serve topped with halved cherry tomatoes and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Margherita pizza
ingredients: 2 large ready-made pizza bases (or 500 g fresh pizza dough)
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) with a baking tray inside.
Mix the passata, tomato purée and oregano and spread thinly over the bases.
Tear over the mozzarella and scatter with the Cheddar.
Bake on the hot tray for 10–12 minutes until the base is crisp and the cheese is bubbling.
Top with basil and a drizzle of oil, slice and serve with salad.
